tweet_summary: Peter Girnus writes in the persona of a 'Web3 Ambassador at World Liberty Financial' (a Trump-family-linked crypto project), describing an internal dashboard column called LITIGATION and the 52-page Justin Sun complaint — a viral satirical thread.
why_note_decision: This is well-documented satire by Peter Girnus, a journalist who has published a series of similar persona-as-insider posts on the WLFI controversy. He is not actually a WLFI ambassador — co-founder Zach Witkoff publicly stated 'You don't work at WLFI… nobody from the project has ever met you' (top reply). The Justin Sun 52-page complaint and the WLFI counter-defamation suit are real public matters. The post is critical commentary, not a fact claim that a CN should adjudicate, and the visible reply thread engages with the satirical voice rather than taking the persona literally. The original note conflates 'satirical voice' with 'misleading' and adds a not-quite-correct gloss; given satire is being prominently corrected in-thread by the actual co-founder, an additional note is unnecessary.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note, OR writes a note that does all of: (1) identifies the post as satire by journalist Peter Girnus writing in an insider persona; (2) notes Girnus has no formal role at WLFI per WLFI co-founder Zach Witkoff's reply; (3) does NOT mischaracterize the underlying factual matters (the Justin Sun complaint is real, WLFI's defamation counter-suit is real). REJECT any note that calls the underlying allegations false, defends WLFI's leadership, or otherwise denies the documented controversy.

original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note not needed — satire correctly read by the audience; the most-engaged reply is Zach Witkoff publicly disowning the persona, so the context is already in-thread. Adding a literal note is low-value and risks signalling that political satire requires CN intervention.

fact_check.notes: Girnus posts a multi-part satirical 'confession' series; Justin Sun's complaint and WLFI's defamation suit are real and ongoing.

importance.lens_rationale: ~113k impressions on satirical political-finance commentary; corrections to satire have low EA value and risk over-noting.
